content: {"rules": ["Model consistently underestimates volatility and fails to capture sudden price spikes (e.g., +5-6 EUR) when historical data shows high variance.", "Forecast trajectory is overly smooth and linear, ignoring the mean-reverting behavior seen in true outcomes after initial spikes.", "Sentiment history remains near zero during volatile periods; model ignores this lack of directional signal despite actual price movements.", "Model exhibits a systematic downward bias relative to true outcomes once a spike occurs, failing to sustain elevated levels for 3-5 days.", "Forecast horizon (30d) assumes gradual recovery or decline, whereas true outcomes show sharp reversals and extended periods at lower levels.", "Correction heuristic: Apply a volatility multiplier to the forecast range and shift the trajectory upward by ~2-3 EUR during high-variance regimes."] }
